fields.why: The headline evaluation claim judges treatment success against the WHO 85% target, so fixed referent leads; pair is also defensible because the only test and several subgroup contrasts are pairwise. The brief gives a precedence rule for pair vs group but none for fixed referent vs pair (a rule such as 'lead with the framework of the headline claim' would decide it).

brief_issues: Add a precedence rule for when a fixed referent and pairwise contrasts coexist (e.g. lead with the framework of the Summary's headline claim). A also mixed the WHO target into comparison.across while choosing pair.
